archetype: 1 (Organic & Earthy) - Modified for Old Money Tech / Academic Editorial
design_principles: Emotion First: The design must feel established, ivy-league, and trustworthy, avoiding standard SaaS "tech" aesthetics.
Contrast over Saturation: Rely on dark forest green and stark whites against warm sand backgrounds.
Negative Space: Generous spacing, let data-dense tables breathe.
Content is King: Strict typography scale, utilizing variable weights.

rules: NEVER use pure #000000. Always tint greys.
NEVER use generic full-screen gradients. NO purple, violet, or teal.
Primary CTA uses #1A362D. Secondary uses #F7F5F0 with #1A362D border.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-serif font-black
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-serif font-bold

rules: Import 'Playfair Display' and 'Outfit' from Google Fonts via CSS.
Headings must always use letter spacing 'tracking-tight'.

surfaces_and_materials.dashboard_cards: Flat solid background (#FFFFFF). 1px subtle border (#E5E1D5), no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
surfaces_and_materials.glassmorphism_nav: For sticky headers or AI widgets: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-white/40 shadow-sm.
surfaces_and_materials.grid_borders: For data tables: Exposed grids. border-collapse with border-b border-[#E5E1D5].

spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: Use 2-3x typical spacing. p-8 or p-12 for standard sections.
spacing_and_layout.marketing_grid: Mode A: Tetris Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 to gap-12. Asymmetrical spans.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Mode B: Control Room Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-6. Every pixel utilized, h-full on children.
spacing_and_layout.container_padding: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.

components.buttons: Square or very slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Primary: bg-[#1A362D] text-white hover:bg-[#264F42] hover:text-white.
components.inputs_and_forms: Use Shadcn customized components. Flat, 1px border. Focus: ring-1 ring-[#1A362D] border-[#1A362D].
components.tables: Dense layout. Data left-aligned. Header rows use overline text styling (uppercase, tracking-[0.2em]).
components.ai_assistant_widget: Floating bottom-right. Glassmorphism panel. Use #D46B4E (Terracotta) for active indicator dot. Message bubbles in #F7F5F0.
components.notices_board: List format with massive gaps (gap-6) between items. Editorial ribbon style.
components.badges: Flat background (e.g., bg-[#F7F5F0]), dark text, 1px border.

icons.usage: 2px stroke, sharp corners if available. Keep simple.

media.description: Premium modern university architecture for landing page hero or auth page split screen. Use with a bg-black/30 or bg-white/20 overlay if text is present.
Group of college students. Use in marketing section to add human element.
Institution building for feature backgrounds or dashboard welcome cards.

rules: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format based on role (e.g., 'login-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT prompt the user or ask clarifying questions. Proceed purely with these guidelines.
Strictly adhere to the Color System and Typography. No AI-style purple/teal gradients.
Use Shadcn UI for dashboard components but override the default rounding to 'rounded-none' or 'rounded-sm' and borders to match the custom #E5E1D5.
Marketing Landing Page must use pure HTML + Tailwind to achieve organic asymmetry. Do NOT rely on pre-built generic section components.
Implement the AI chat widget with the provided glassmorphism rules, avoiding generic chatbot templates.
Ensure all dashboard tables and lists (Student/Parent/Teacher views) are data-dense but highly readable via #F7F5F0 backgrounds.
Use only the provided media URLs for all images.
